observations: Initial headless screenshots sometimes omit part of the header badges while DOM bounds, visibility, text and hit targets are correct.
A second headless screenshot in one sequence captured only the sky background.
A later read-only bounds/style inspection and screenshot captured the full scene and badges.
A separate headed Chrome screenshot retained the scene and badges but omitted several SVG shell titles.
interpretation: These captures do not establish whether the cause is screenshot/compositor behavior or an application paint defect. DOM and timing passes do not resolve it.
